$meta.interval_label: Terminal Maastrichtian (~68–66 Ma), western North America — land & freshwater: Hell Creek / Lance Formation; sea: Fox Hills / retreating Western Interior Seaway & European Maastrichtian type area (Mosasaurus hoffmannii).
$meta.law_1_note: Each organism's ageRange_Ma must overlap interval_Ma (SCOPE Law #1). Verified by tools/roster_audit.py.
$meta.schema: SCOPE §5. Factual fields filled where confident; blurb/funFacts/references left for sourced fill (do not fabricate — Law #4). `needsRefs:true` flags swapped-in taxa awaiting the ref pipeline. Glyph note: all `type` values map to the 7 locked glyphs; no birds/amphibians in V1 (avoids a glyph gap — candidates for a later volume).
$meta.roster_changes_2026-07-09: Swapped 7 temporal fails + 2 tightenings for genuine terminal-Maastrichtian taxa: Pteranodon→Dakotaraptor; Struthiomimus→Ornithomimus; Dracorex renamed to Pachycephalosaurus (juvenile synonym); Deinosuchus→Borealosuchus; Archelon→Basilemys; Hesperornis→Lepisosteus (gar); Ichthyornis→Myledaphus (ray); Protostega→Palaeosaniwa (monitor lizard); Elasmosaurus→Prognathodon. Kept borderline Xiphactinus/Enchodus/Squalicorax/Baculites (ranges overlap 66 Ma); Inoceramus kept with a decline note.
